note: Corps of Engineers park on Truman Lake off Highway 7 north-west of Warsaw, with Long Shoal Marina, a swimming beach and a boat ramp. Gravel pads in wooded loops; the east-side sites (47-49, 64-70, 97-98) face open grass toward the lake. Limit of one wheeled camper and two tents, or three tents, per pad. --Claude
summary: Confirmed lakeview (no site earns lakefront). Fees 14-35 with peak span; 50A (rec.gov description; catalog says 30) + water, no sewer; 94 sites; showers/flush/vault/water; season Mar 1 - Nov 30 from the calendar; rec.gov booking, 14 nights, notice weekend/holiday minimums. PIN moves ~650 m; phone 660-438-2342 to add.
flags: PIN (move ~650 m): stored 38.2761,-93.4697 is the recreation.gov facility point, in woods north of the campground. The 94 catalog site points centre on 38.27037,-93.46808 (sites 001-122 between 38.2685-38.2724, -93.4663 to -93.4703); imagery shows the gravel loops there. Move to 38.2704,-93.4681.

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept; no lakefront): the loops are wooded; only the east edge (sites 47-49, 64-70, 97-98) faces the lake across an open mown/grass meadow. Measured on imagery (taken at a low pool, mud flats exposed): site 70 ~62 m to the top of the bank and ~80 m to water, site 69 ~85 m, sites 66-67 140 m+, sites 48-49 ~90 m to the south cove. Site photos 049 and 069 (2019, a high pool with water standing in the grass) show open grass and the lake beyond at a distance. None is within 50 m of normal shoreline with an open apron, so no lakefront; the open-meadow view supports lakeview.

AMPERAGE CONFLICT: the recreation.gov description says '44 sites with 50-amp electric and water hookups, 38 sites with 30-amp'; the per-site catalog lists 'Electricity Hookup 30' on all 82 electric sites, including the 44 water sites (which carry their own higher $35 peak rate). Wrote 50 from the description; if catalog amperage governs, it is 30.
PHONE (missing): recreation.gov facility phone 660-438-2342 - add it.
Rec.gov rules carry militaryDiscount 1 (not written). Check-in 9:00 AM per catalog. The rec.gov notice's weekend/holiday minimums are recorded although the rule fields are 0.
